_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: Dry brass anti-siphon outdoor hose bib on a stucco wall above a paver path
figures.caption: Confirm the shutoff, pipe material, wall penetration, and exposure before removing an outdoor hose bib. The exterior fixture is only the visible end of a water line that needs to stay supported inside the wall.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Accessible water shutoff and supply connections at a utility water heater
figures.caption: Isolate the water supply before disturbing the connection, then support the pipe while the old fitting is removed. Do not twist or load the line hidden behind the exterior wall just to free the visible bib.

figures.alt: Rock-lined swale carrying water away from a Florida foundation
figures.caption: Seal the wall penetration and verify that the shutoff closes fully before the repair is finished. Exterior plumbing and drainage both need to keep water moving outside rather than into a damp wall cavity or foundation area.
